# Artemisia College

> > Artemisia College (ACAD) offers BFA programs in Animation, Game Design, Fashion Design, and Interior Design with Unreal Engine partnership in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Located at the IICHE building near Geetabhawan Square in Indore, Artemisia College provides creative education programs with industry-standard tools like Unity and Unreal Engine. The college features student clubs, portfolio-based early admission, and both online and offline application options for domestic and international students.

## Key Topics

- Animation programs
- Game Design education
- Fashion Design courses
- Interior Design programs
- BFA degrees
- Unreal Engine partnership
- Unity game development

- Indore creative college

- Design education in Madhya Pradesh

## Programs & Admissions

- [Home - Artemisia College](https://www.artemisiacollege.com): Main homepage for BFA programs and Unreal Engine partnership
- [Early Admission](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/early-admission): Portfolio-based early admission process bypassing ACAD Entrance Exam
- [Fee Structure](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/fee-structure): Tuition fees for Animation, Game, Fashion, Interior Design programs
- [Apply Offline](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/apply-offline): Offline application procedure with courier submission to IICHE building
- [International Student Application Form](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/international-student-application-form): Application form for international student admissions
- [ACAD Online Courses Form](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/acad-online-course-form): ACAD online course enrollment and registration form

## Student Work & Showcase

- [Demo - Student Showcase](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/showcase/demo): Utkarsh Rastogi's Super Bike Nova Unity game demo showcase
- [Night People - Student Project](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/student-work/night-people): Utkarsh Rastogi's Night People Unity hypercasual game project

- [Student Clubs](https://www.artemisiacollege.com/student-clubs): Extracurricular clubs including ACAD Spectre Gaming and Otaku Club
